title: Leray comparison when direct-image higher derived functors vanish
statement: Let f:Z\to X be a continuous map of topological spaces [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], let f_* be the direct-image functor on abelian sheaves [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] given by (f_*F)(U)=F(f^{-1}U), and let R^qf_* be its right derived functors [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. If R^qf_*F=0 for every q>0, then for every p>=0 the Leray edge map gives a natural isomorphism H^p(Z,F)\cong H^p(X,f_*F) [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].

proof.text: Apply exists_topological_leray_spectralSequence from [lem-sc-topological-leray-spectral-sequence]. Transport HX and HZ by their equalities with the cohomology-presheaf functors evaluated on the terminal opens. Its canonical map a, edge natural transformations, generator formula, and injective-resolution cocycle formula give exactly the corresponding witnesses and first conjunct of the statement.

Fix an acyclic sheaf F and evaluate the functor-valued spectral sequence at F. Evaluation preserves finite limits and colimits. For q>0 the E_2 terms vanish because extFunctorObj sends the zero derived direct-image object to zero. A zero page term has zero cycles (a subobject) and zero homology (a quotient of cycles), so induction on integer pages makes every positive-row term zero on every page. At (p,0) the outgoing differential is zero by the first-quadrant shape; a possible incoming differential has source in row r-1>0 and hence becomes zero after evaluation. Kernel and cokernel universal properties therefore make the evaluated iCycles and homology projection isomorphisms. The defining transition equation expresses each evaluated bottom transition as the inverse of iCycles followed by the homology projection and the page isomorphism.
